spans.code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, status

app = FastAPI()
items = {1: {"name": "pen"}}

@app.get("/items/{item_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
async def read_item(item_id: int):
    item = items.get(item_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Item not found")
    return item

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

with TestClient(app) as client:
    response = client.get("/items/99")
    print(response.status_code, response.json())

spans.title: Practical tip
spans.text: For a successful POST that creates a resource, use `status_code=201`; test both success and missing-resource cases.

spans.title: One level deeper
spans.text: 422 indicates request-shape/type validation failure; 404 means the application could not find a resource. Test them separately.

spans.title: Important warning
spans.text: Do not use `assert` for user input: optimized Python can remove assertions. Use validation and `HTTPException` for API errors.
